title: Mercury hollows: code and derived data for a hollow formation model
description: Analysis code, derived data, analysis records, and figure scripts behind a model of how hollows form on Mercury (Phillips, in preparation). The record contains: the 19,110 hollow detections of Bickel et al. (2025) at positions recomputed through the MDIS camera model; the 6,731 merged hollows and 1,228 hollow fields; imaging coverage, the fitted detection model, and completeness grids; host-crater assignments; the thermal-model grid and the hot-longitude temperature excess; the northern smooth plains mask; peak, floor, and wall terrain densities; the Caloris penetration test; slope and depth analyses of the shadow-length depths of Blewett et al. (2016); the sulfur-charging calculations; the records of every fit; the figure scripts; and the data behind each figure. A script reruns every analysis that needs only the included data. The crater containment graph used in the paper is a separate record (mercury-crater-graph).
